name: Zorua & Zoroark ex Starter Set ex

releases.name: Zorua & Zoroark ex Starter Set ex

description.text: Starter Set ex Zorua & Zoroark ex, released on 31 July 2026 with Eevee ex's and Sprigatito & Meowscarada ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck of Darkness Pokémon, with two Zoroark ex and a full-illustration Zorua. For a single Darkness Energy, Zoroark ex's first attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play, and its second does 210 but can't be used again the next turn. Liepard's attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on the opponent's Active Pokémon, and Darkrai and Sharpedo join them. Damage counters and markers of paper, a coin and a playmat of its own, a player's guide and a how-to-play booklet came with it, and some of its cards are reprints from earlier series.
